title: Azure Automation retires Python 2.7/3.8 and PowerShell 7.1/7.2 runtimes
summary: Microsoft retires support for the Python 2.7 and 3.8, and PowerShell 7.1 and 7.2 runtime versions in Azure Automation; runbooks on these versions stop receiving support and security updates.

sources.title: Retirement: Support for Python-2.7, 3.8 and PowerShell-7.1, 7.2 will be retired on September 30, 2026

title: Azure AI Foundry retires GPT-4o
summary: Microsoft's Foundry Models lifecycle policy lists GPT-4o in Azure AI Foundry (Azure OpenAI Service) as retiring on September 30, 2026; deployments not migrated to a replacement model by then will stop serving inference calls.

sources.title: Foundry Models lifecycle and support policy

title: Azure Maps Service Module and Map Control 2.0.x reach retirement
summary: Microsoft retires the Azure Maps Web SDK Map Control version 2.0.x and the separate Azure Maps Service Module on September 30, 2026, directing developers to Map Control v3 and the Azure Maps JavaScript REST SDK respectively.

sources.title: Azure Maps Web SDK Map Control version 2.0.x and Azure Maps Service Module will be retired on 30 September 2026

title: Azure Network Policy Manager for Windows AKS nodes retires
summary: Support for Azure Network Policy Manager on Windows nodes in AKS ends by this date, with no direct first-party replacement; Microsoft points to node-level NSGs, self-managed Calico, or workload redesign.

sources.title: Retirement: Azure Network Policy Manager (NPM) for Windows nodes on AKS
Retirement: Azure Network Policy Manager (NPM) for Windows nodes on AKS

title: Azure retires legacy Service Bus SDKs and SBMP protocol
summary: Microsoft retires the WindowsAzure.ServiceBus, Microsoft.Azure.ServiceBus and com.microsoft.azure.servicebus libraries, along with the SBMP protocol, on this date for not meeting current Azure SDK guidelines.

sources.title: Service Bus Track 0 and 1 SDK support retirement

title: Azure retires NVv3-series GPU VM sizes (Standard_NV12s_v3-NV48s_v3)
summary: Microsoft retires the NVv3-series GPU virtual machine sizes, Standard_NV12s_v3 through Standard_NV48s_v3, on September 30, 2026; instances are deallocated and unsupported after this date, with UAE North given an extension to January 31, 2027.

sources.title: NVv3 series retirement

title: Azure retires NVv4-series GPU virtual machines
summary: Microsoft retires the Standard_NV4as_v4 through NV32ahs_v4 GPU virtual machine sizes on this date, recommending migration to the NVadsV710_v5 series.

sources.title: NVv4-series retirement

title: Azure Virtual Desktop (classic) retires
summary: Azure Virtual Desktop (classic), the pre-ARM 2019 offering, stops working entirely on September 30, 2026, with no new session hosts and no access to existing ones; organizations must migrate to current Azure Virtual Desktop.

sources.title: Azure Virtual Desktop (classic) retirement
